title: [main] [Order Planning] Production copy allows Req. worksheet templates that cannot create production orders
summary: Production order copying in Order Planning now restricts the destination to nonrecurring Planning-type worksheets only, preventing invalid selections that would silently lose production demand when carrying out actions.
key_points: Production copy action restricted to Planning worksheet templates with Recurring = false
Template Type filter added to prevent selecting Requisition worksheets that cannot create production orders
Option renamed from 'Copy to Req. Wksh.' to 'Copy to Planning Wksh.' to reflect actual constraint
Prevents silent data loss when production lines are left unprocessed and deleted during nonrecurring batch cleanup
Validation ensures worksheet destination matches production order carry-out capability
quote: Restrict the production copy to the only destination that can carry it out - a nonrecurring Planning-type worksheet.
